commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
88' Today's match ends for Piotr Zielinski who will be replaced by Petar Sucic (Inter).
86' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
84' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp will be replaced by Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese).
83' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
81' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:5.
77' Substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan makes his way off the pitch and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on as his replacement.
77' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Francesco Acerbi (Inter) replaces Carlos Augusto.
77' Udinese are ruled offside.
75' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Arthur Atta is replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
75' It will be a substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Alessandro Zanoli walks off.
75' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) replacing Christian Kabasele.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
73' It seemed like Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
71' Udinese are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
70' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Carlos Augusto (Inter) for his blatant foul.
70' Two players stand over the free kick. Nicolo Barella (Inter) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
69' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Inter.
67' The substitution has been made. Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) has replaced Francesco Pio Esposito.
66' Lennon Miller (Udinese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Manuel Akanji (Inter) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
61' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
59' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Maduka Okoye comes off his line to intercept.
57' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) commits a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

53' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Maduka Okoye makes a great save to stop his effort.
51' Manuel Akanji (Inter) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
50' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
48' Inter are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Di Bello starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Luis Henrique (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lennon Miller (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Jakub Piotrowski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
44' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' The game is interrupted now, Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' Luis Henrique (Inter) commits a foul and Marco Di Bello immediately signals a free kick.
40' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
39' The ball rebounds back to Nicolo Barella (Inter) on the edge of the box and he produces another shot, just to see it fly wide of the target.

37' Federico Dimarco almost found himself in a promising position after Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.

35' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Di Bello with no other option than to blow for a foul.
34' A neat pass is well received by Keinan Davis (Udinese), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
32' A spell of possession for Udinese in an attempt to control the game.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is about to take a corner kick.
29' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

29' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Maduka Okoye, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
26' The corner is flicked onto Manuel Akanji (Inter), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post.
25' Inter earn a corner.
24' Inter are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 27:73.
20' 0 - 1 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
19' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) does superbly to reach the lofted pass from Luis Henrique into the centre of the box, but his header is weak and drifts well past the left post.
16' Some neat passing and movement from Inter as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
13' Yann Bisseck (Inter) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Maduka Okoye.
13' Lautaro Martinez receives a sweet cross inside the box from Manuel Akanji (Inter), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
12' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
10' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
7' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) serves up a nice cross, but Yann Sommer punches the ball away.
5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Yann Bisseck (Inter).

4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Maduka Okoye leaps like a salmon to deny him.
3' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Inter are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
1' The match has just started.
